item.title: Timeline of what happened each day of Nancy Guthrie disappearance
item.description: Authorities have increased the reward to $100,000 for information leading to the whereabouts of Nancy Guthrie, who was abducted from her home outside Tucson, and have released a description of the man caught on camera outside her front door the night she disappeared.

item.title: Surveillance video captures North Side burglary
item.description: Surveillance video captured the moment burglars broke into a Lincoln Park business, one of multiple smash and grab burglaries recently reported on the city's North Side.

item.title: Chicago postal worker caught on camera singing, community rallies to buy him a car
item.description: Lavonte Harvey, a 23-year-old letter carrier in Chicago, went viral for singing while on his route, and a GoFundMe was started to help him buy a car after he was found to be struggling with transportation.

item.title: Emergency crews battling house fire in Austin
Matrix Club Banquet Hall closure leaves schools scrambling to find venues to host prom, dances
item.description: Schools in the western suburbs are scrambling to find alternate sites for proms and school events after the Matrix Club Banquet Hall in Naperville abruptly closed its doors this week.

item.title: Chase ditches Chicago skyline themed cards
item.description: For decades, Chicagoans have been able to show their city pride with an image of the skyline on their Chase debit cards; but a spokesperson confirmed that the bank is no longer making cards with the image, and the internet isn't happy.
